description: This file is a shell script designed to configure and manage a Wi-Fi router's interface settings, hostapd, DHCP, bridge interfaces, and related networking components. It includes functions to restart hostapd processes, configure bridge and wireless interfaces, adjust DHCP settings, and control web server and DNS services.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd process for 2.4GHz Wi-Fi interface, killing existing processes and relaunching.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd process for 5GHz Wi-Fi interface modules rtl8812au and 88x2bu.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Performs a restart sequence for hostapd, including killing existing process and restarting it.
